headline: Liberty Steel Dalzell Financial Troubles Raise Questions Over Navy Contracts
summary: Liberty Steel's Dalzell plate mill in Motherwell, Scotland, has struggled to pay supplier bills and workers despite holding an order for 34,000 tonnes of steel plate for three Royal Navy warships.
why: Liberty Steel is a major British steel producer; financial instability at its specialized mills creates risks for UK sovereign defense procurement.

impacts.name: Liberty Steel
impacts.why: Cash flow difficulties threaten Liberty Steel's capability to execute military shipbuilding contracts.
